gates.citation: Romberg test; paired t (Student 1908). Reference impls: scipy.stats.ttest_rel and base R t.test(paired=TRUE). Data: eyes-closed vs eyes-open foam-surface COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics), Santos & Duarte (2016) balance dataset.

reference.citation: Romberg test; paired t (Student 1908). Reference impls: scipy.stats.ttest_rel and base R t.test(paired=TRUE). Data: eyes-closed vs eyes-open foam-surface COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics), Santos & Duarte (2016) balance dataset.
reference.description: re-computes the paired t-test of eyes-closed vs eyes-open foam sway with scipy.stats.ttest_rel and base R t.test(paired=TRUE) and confirms pairedTTest reproduces BOTH bit-for-bit; also reports the eyes-closed/eyes-open mean sway ratio, the number of subjects with EC > EO, and the subject count
